listings.remarksConcat: Gracefully elevated on a private cul-de-sac, this majestic Lakemont residence blends timeless architecture with exceptional livability. Situated on an oversized private lot, this thoughtfully designed flowing floor-plan is equally suited for grand entertaining and intimate everyday living. A dramatic two-story entry welcomes you inside, where soaring ceilings and Palladian windows fill the formal living room with natural light. The versatile layout features a second staircase leading to a private 4th bedroom with ensuite bath on its own level, ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a bonus retreat. Continue upstairs to the luxurious primary suite, a true sanctuary, offering a sitting room with fireplace, a beautifully renovated spa-inspired bath with soaking tub, oversized shower, and walk-in closet. Two more spacious bedrooms and an updated full bath complete this level.  Outdoor living shines here with a large entertainment deck, BBQ area, hot tub, play space, and arboretum-like setting that provides a peaceful "in the woods" experience just minutes from shopping, I-90, and sought-after Cougar Ridge Elementary. 3-car garage, and many updates complete this exceptional Lakemont home.

listings.remarksConcat: Stunning lake views, versatile living spaces, and an unbeatable walkable lifestyle! Location, location, location! A rare opportunity ideally positioned in one of Seattle's sought-after neighborhoods. This home offers easy access to I-5, biking and jogging paths, dog walking, sports fields, boutique coffee shops, restaurants and shopping. A welcoming covered porch and high ceilings greet you as you enter the main level featuring an elegant formal living and dining room, a beautifully updated kitchen with captivating lake views, and a spacious family room opening to an entertainment deck overlooking the water. A bedroom, laundry and powder room complete this level. Upstairs, a generous bonus room opens to an expansive view deck showcasing panoramic lake vistas and Seattle sunsets. The lovely primary suite has vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, a custom walk-in closet, and a beautifully remodeled spa-inspired bath with freestanding tub. An additional bedroom with ensuite bath completes the upper level. The lower level provides incredible flexibility with its large living area and fireplace, kitchenette, bedroom, full bath, and its own private access to the garage and backyard. This space is ideal for guests, multigenerational living, extended stays, or income producing rental. Complete with a two-car garage, this dreamy home is just steps from Green Lake with its charming neighborhood shops, restaurants and all that makes this vibrant Seattle community so desirable.
